name: Hyatt Hotels
description: Hyatt runs about 1,500 hotels and all-inclusive resorts (372,763 rooms at 2025 year end) but owns almost none of the real estate: 682 properties are managed for third-party owners, 700 are franchised, and only 28 are owned or leased. It earns base and incentive management fees and franchise royalties (gross fees $1.25 billion in 2025), plus revenue from its remaining owned and leased hotels and from ALG Vacations and Mr & Mrs Smith, which sell travel packages and bookings for commission. A large share of reported revenue ($3.6 billion of $7.1 billion in 2025) is simply reimbursement of costs, mainly payroll at managed hotels, that owners repay at no profit. In June 2025 it bought Playa Hotels & Resorts, then sold the whole 15-resort Playa real estate portfolio for about $2 billion within the year, keeping the all-inclusive brands and management contracts.
